ev.q: Overall, booster coverage varied by race and ethnicity, ranging from 37.3% among Hispanic persons to 58.5% among non-Hispanic Asian persons.
Second booster dose coverage was lowest among males, Hispanic and Black persons, persons living in rural counties, and Janssen primary series recipients.
Booster coverage increased with age, ranging from 15.6% among children aged 5–11 years to 69.5% among adults aged ≥65 years.
Second booster dose coverage increased with age, ranging from 26.1% among persons aged 50–64 years to 41.4% among those aged ≥75 years.
